claude-mem v1.0.1 changelog:

- Initial public release of the claude-mem OpenClaw plugin and worker service.
- Added full setup documentation and quick install script.
- Included end-to-end tests, install scripts, and TypeScript sources for plugin logic.
- Sample skills added: do-plan and make-plan, each with their own setup guides.
- Provided automated and manual setup options for persistent agent memory with memory file sync and observation feed.

Claude-Mem OpenClaw Plugin v1.0.0 — Initial public release

- Adds persistent agent memory for OpenClaw via the claude-mem plugin and worker service.
- Automatic install/upgrade script for fast, interactive setup.
- Manual setup instructions for advanced users or troubleshooting.
- MEMORY.md file auto-syncs agent observation timeline in real time.
- Optional observation feed streams live memory updates to messaging channels (Telegram, Discord, Slack).
- Detailed configuration steps and verification guides included.
